verses.text: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea, during King Herod’s time. Then wise men from the east arrived in Jerusalem, asking, ✨
“Where is the child born King of the Jews? We saw his star out east and came to worship him.” 🌟
When King Herod heard this, he was troubled—and all Jerusalem with him.
He gathered the chief priests and scribes and asked them where the Christ was to be born.
They answered, “In Bethlehem of Judea. The prophet wrote this:
‘You, Bethlehem in Judah, are no small place among Judah’s princes; from you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’”
Then Herod quietly called the wise men and got the exact time the star had appeared.
He sent them to Bethlehem and said, “Go search carefully for the child. When you find him, report back, so I can go worship him too.”
They heard the king and set out. The star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stopped above the place where the child was. 🧭
When they saw the star, joy hit them big-time—overwhelming joy. 🌟
They entered the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother. They bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and offered him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh. 🎁
A dream warned them not to return to Herod, so they went back to their own country by another route.

After they left, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream: “Get up. Take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, because Herod is going to search for the child to kill him.”
Joseph got up, took the child and his mother by night, and left for Egypt. 🌙
He stayed there until Herod died. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

When Herod realized the wise men had outsmarted him, he flew into a rage. He ordered the killing of all the boys aged two and under in Bethlehem and the surrounding region, based on the exact time he had learned from the wise men.
Then what the prophet Jeremiah had spoken came to pass:
“A voice was heard in Ramah—crying, weeping, deep mourning. Rachel was weeping for her children; she would not be comforted, because they were gone.”
After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream while he was in Egypt.
“Get up. Take the child and his mother and go to Israel, because those who were trying to take the child’s life are dead.”
Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and returned to the land of Israel.
But when he heard Archelaus was ruling Judea in place of his father Herod, Joseph was afraid to go there. Warned in a dream, he went instead to the region of Galilee.
He settled in a city called Nazareth. This fulfilled what the prophets had spoken: “He will be called a Nazarene.” 🏡
